description: Teritoriālās zonas siltumapgādes veida izvēlei is a dataset listed in data.gov.lv, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rīgas dome. The data set contains information on Riga City Council Binding Regulation No RD-24-260-sn of 21 February 2024 (Record No 113, 27. Coverage: Rīgas dome. The portal shows the English title as "Territorial areas to choose the type of heating" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Rīgas dome. Its keywords include GEO RĪGA, Gaisa piesārņojums, Siltumapgāde, Centralizēta siltumapgādes sistēma, centrālapkure, Vietējā siltumapgāde. The listing shows 4 download or service links in SHP, DXF, KML, GPKG. The listing shows 2024-10-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lv.
